Dear Mr. Upton,

Re: Your Dispute of Account ACC-600149

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding the accuracy of the account information on your credit report. We understand that you have requested an investigation into the account, citing your rights under 15 USC 1681e(b) and 15 USC 1681i.

We confirm that the account in question, ACC-600149, is a collection account in our possession. According to our records, the original creditor for this account is Horizon Card Co. The current balance on this account is $20,370.53. We have verified that the charge-off date for this account is May 8, 2022, and the last payment date was March 28, 2023.

We will conduct a thorough investigation into the accuracy of the account information as requested. We will review our records and verify the information with the original creditor, Horizon Card Co. If our investigation confirms that the information is accurate, we will provide you with a validation of the account. If, however, our investigation reveals that the information is incorrect, we will take the necessary steps to correct the account and ensure the accuracy of the credit report.

Please note that under the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to investigate your dispute and provide a response within 30 days. We will keep you informed of our progress and will provide you with an update on the status of our investigation.

You have the right to continue to dispute this account and to request that it be removed from your credit report if it cannot be verified. Please let us know if you have any further questions or concerns.

Sincerely,

Keystone Account Solutions
